name: zep
description: Wraps graphiti-core (getzep/graphiti, the open-source engine behind "Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory", arXiv:2501.13956, family C, BASELINE_METRIC_PLAN.md §4): ingests each conversation chunk as an episode via LLM-driven entity/relation extraction into a temporal knowledge graph (embedded Kuzu backend, no external server), answers via hybrid vector+text search over graph edges feeding a QA prompt. Comparison point alongside mem0/langmem/a_mem/memoryos for whether a real memory-agent framework beats plain RAG (bm25_rag/dense_rag) or a rolling summary (running_summary).
author: Wnsdnl
